newsitem.title: USA: FoxMeyer Drug places $140 mln in orders.
newsitem.headline: FoxMeyer Drug places $140 mln in orders.

text.p: FoxMeyer Drug Co, a unit of FoxMeyer Health Corp that is currently in Chapter 11 bankruptcy, said on Wednesday it has placed orders for approximately $140 million in new inventory.
The inventory will be shipped to customers within the next few days to fill current orders, FoxMeyer Drug said.

FoxMeyer Drug's ability to purchase inventory of this magnitude is a direct result of $30 million in cash received from McKesson Corp through a participation in the Company's existing debtor in possession financing with GE Capital Services, it said.
McKesson agreed on October 4 to acquire FoxMeyer Drug and its affiliated companies for $80 million, FoxMeyer Drug said.
Under the Bankruptcy Code, the sale is subject to open bidding, making it possible for other bidders to come forward, the company said.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to discharge liabilities and satisfy creditors' claims in the Chapter 11 cases of FoxMeyer Drug and certain of its affiliated companies, FoxMeyer Drug said.
U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Wilmington, Del., has set November 8, 1996 as the date for a hearing to consider the sale, FoxMeyer Drug said.
